Title: Azure Policy non-compliance reasoning and change history features

Body.Content:
Azure Policy is the best way to codify company policies into the core of Azure, reducing the time taken with external approval processes and documentation.

New functionalities have been added to Azure Policy, including non-compliance reasoning and change history features. This means that you’ll be able to see why a resource evaluated as non-complaint and what changes were implemented directly by a policy.
